It was renamed University College, Cardiff in 1972 and merged with the University of Wales Institute of Science and Technology in 1988 to become University of Wales College, Cardiff and then University of Wales, Cardiff in 1996. In 1997, it received degree-awarding powers, but held them in abeyance. It adopted the operating name of Cardiff University in 1999; this became its legal name in 2005, when it became an independent university awarding its own degrees.

name: Hokkaido University
history: Hokkaido University (北海道大学, Hokkaidō daigaku), or Hokudai (北大), is a public research university in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan. Founded in 1918, it is the fifth-oldest government-authorised university in Japan and one of the former Imperial Universities.

name: Queen's University at Kingston
history: Queen's University at Kingston, commonly known as Queen's University or simply Queen's, is a public research university in Kingston, Ontario, Canada. Queen's holds more than 1,400 hectares (3,500 acres) of land throughout Ontario and owns Herstmonceux Castle in East Sussex, England. Queen's is organized into eight faculties and schools.

name: Michigan State University
history: Michigan State University (Michigan State or MSU) is a public land-grant research university in East Lansing, Michigan, United States. It was founded in 1855 as the Agricultural College of the State of Michigan, the first of its kind in the country. After the introduction of the Morrill Act in 1862, the state designated the college a land-grant institution in 1863, making it the first of the land-grant colleges in the United States. The college became coeducational in 1870. Michigan State has facilities across the state, and over 550,500 alumni.

name: Emory University
history: Emory University is a private research university in Atlanta, Georgia, United States. It was founded in 1836 as Emory College by the Methodist Episcopal Church and named in honor of Methodist bishop John Emory. Its main campus is in Druid Hills, four miles (six kilometers) from downtown Atlanta.

name: University of Cape Town
history: The University of Cape Town (UCT) (Afrikaans: Universiteit van Kaapstad, Xhosa: iYunivesithi yaseKapa) is a public research university in Cape Town, South Africa.

name: Technische Universität Dresden
history: TU Dresden (German: Technische Universität Dresden, TUD), officially using the English name TUD Dresden University of Technology, is a public research university in Dresden, Germany. It is the largest institute of higher education in the city of Dresden, the largest university in Saxony, and one of the 10 largest universities in Germany with 29,000 students as of 2024. TU Dresden has held the title of University of Excellence since 2012 and was confirmed in the German Excellence Strategy in 2019 and 2026.

name: Universidad de Chile
history: The University of Chile (Spanish: Universidad de Chile) is a public research university in Santiago, Chile. It was founded on November 19, 1842, and inaugurated on September 17, 1843. It is the oldest university in the country. It was established as the continuation of the former colonial Royal University of San Felipe (1738) (Spanish: Real Universidad de San Felipe), and has a rich history in academic, scientific and social outreach. The university seeks to solve national and regional issues and to contribute to the development of Chile.

name: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
history: The Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (abbreviated as VU Amsterdam or simply VU when in context) is a public research university in Amsterdam, Netherlands, founded in 1880. The VU Amsterdam is one of two large, publicly funded research universities in the city, the other being the University of Amsterdam (UvA). The literal translation of the Dutch name Vrije Universiteit is "Free University". "Free" refers to independence of the university from both the State and the Dutch Reformed Church. Both within and outside the university, the institution is commonly referred to as "the VU". Although founded as a private institution, the VU has received government funding on a parity basis with public universities since 1970. The university is located on a compact urban campus in the southern Buitenveldert neighbourhood of Amsterdam and adjacent to the modern Zuidas business district.

name: Tecnológico de Monterrey
history: The Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey (ITESM) (English: Monterrey Institute of Technology and Higher Education), commonly known as the Tecnológico de Monterrey (English: Technological of Monterrey), as Tec de Monterrey or simply as El Tec, is a private research university based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico. It has expanded to include 35 campuses across 25 cities in the country and 22 liaison offices in 15 other countries.
encyclopediaTitle: Monterrey Institute of Technology and Higher Education

name: Curtin University
history: Curtin University (previously Curtin University of Technology and Western Australian Institute of Technology) is an Australian public research university based in Bentley, Perth, Western Australia. It is named after John Curtin, Prime Minister of Australia from 1941 to 1945, and is Western Australia's largest university, with 58,607 students in 2022.

name: Harbin Institute of Technology
history: The Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT) is a public science and engineering university in Nan'gang, Harbin, Heilongjiang, China. It is one of the top universities in China and is affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The university is part of Project 211, Project 985, and the Double First-Class Construction. The university is a member of the C9 League.

name: National Cheng Kung University (NCKU)
history: NCKU began in 1931 as Tainan Technical College. It became Provincial Cheng Kung University in 1956 and gained its present national-university designation in 1971.

name: Technische Universität Wien
history: TU Wien (German: Technische Universität Wien) is a public research university in Vienna, Austria.

name: Universitas Indonesia
history: The University of Indonesia (Indonesian: Universitas Indonesia, abbreviated as UI) is an Indonesian public university located in Jakarta and Depok, West Java. It is one of the oldest tertiary-level educational institutions in Indonesia (known as the Dutch East Indies when UI was established), and is generally considered one of the most prestigious universities in Indonesia, along with the Gadjah Mada University and Bandung Institute of Technology. In the 2024 QS World Universities Ranking, UI is ranked 1st in Indonesia, 49th in Asia and 237th in the world.

name: University of Bern
history: The University of Bern (German: Universität Bern; French: Université de Berne; Latin: Universitas Bernensis) is a public research university in the Swiss capital of Bern. It was founded in 1834. It is regulated and financed by the canton of Bern. It is a comprehensive university offering a broad choice of courses and programs in eight faculties and some 150 institutes. With around 19,000 students, the University of Bern is the third largest university in Switzerland.

name: University of Wollongong
history: The University of Wollongong (UOW) is an Australian public research university located in the suburb of Keiraville, within the coastal city of Wollongong, New South Wales, approximately 80 kilometres (50 mi) south of Sydney. As of 2023, the university had an enrolment of more than 33,000 students (including over 12,300 international students), an alumni base of more than 176,000 [LC1] and over 2,400 staff members including 16 distinguished professors.

name: Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain)
history: UCLouvain (or Université catholique de Louvain [ynivɛʁsite katɔlik də luvɛ̃], French for Catholic University of Louvain, officially in English the University of Louvain) is Belgium's largest French-speaking university and one of the oldest in Europe (originally established in 1425). It is located in Louvain-la-Neuve, which was expressly built to house the university, and has smaller campuses in Brussels, Charleroi, Mons, Tournai and Namur. Since September 2018, the university uses the branding UCLouvain, replacing the acronym UCL, following a merger with Saint-Louis University, Brussels.

name: University of Reading
history: The University of Reading (  RED-ing) is a public research university in Reading, Berkshire, England. It was founded in 1892 as the University Extension College, Reading, an extension college of Christ Church, Oxford, and became University College, Reading in 1902. The institution became a university with the power to grant its own degrees in 1926 by royal charter from King George V, and was the only university to receive such a charter between the two world wars. The university is usually categorised as a red brick university, reflecting its original foundation in the 19th century.

name: University of Otago
history: The University of Otago (Māori: Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka) is a public research collegiate university based in Dunedin, Otago, New Zealand. It was established by ordinance of the Otago Provincial Council in 1869 and opened for teaching in 1871, making it New Zealand's oldest university. Between 1874 and 1961 Otago was part of the University of New Zealand and conferred degrees in its name. In July 2023 the university adopted the Māori identity Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka as part of a major rebrand, with the changes taking effect from May 2024.

name: Complutense University of Madrid
history: The Complutense University of Madrid (Spanish: Universidad Complutense de Madrid, UCM; Latin: Universitas Complutensis Matritensis) is a public research university located in Madrid. Founded in Alcalá in 1293 (before relocating to Madrid in 1836), it is one of the oldest operating universities in the world. It is located on a sprawling campus that occupies the entirety of the Ciudad Universitaria district of Madrid, with annexes in the district of Somosaguas in the neighboring city of Pozuelo de Alarcón. It is named after the ancient Roman settlement of Complutum, now an archeological site in Alcalá de Henares, just east of Madrid.

name: King Abdulaziz University (KAU)
history: King Abdulaziz University (KAU) (Arabic: جامعة الملك عبد العزيز) is a public research university in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Established in 1967 as a private university by a group of businessmen led by Muhammad Bakhashab and including author Hamza Bogary, it was named after the country's first monarch, King Abdulalziz ibn Saud. It was converted into a public university by King Faisal in 1974.

name: The Ohio State University
history: Ohio State began in 1870 as the Ohio Agricultural and Mechanical College. Teaching started in 1873; the institution took its present university name in 1878.

name: Waseda University
history: Waseda University , abbreviated as Waseda  or Sōdai , is a private research university in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

name: Loughborough University
history: Loughborough University  is a public research university in the market town of Loughborough, Leicestershire, England.

name: Università di Padova
history: The University of Padua  is an Italian public research university in Padua, Italy.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT-KGP)
history: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur or IIT Kharagpur is a public institute of technology, research university, and autonomous institute established by the Government of India in Kharagpur, West Bengal.

name: Gadjah Mada University
history: Gadjah Mada University  is a public research university located in Sleman, Special Region of Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

name: Politecnico di Torino
history: The Polytechnic University of Turin  is the oldest Italian public technical university.

name: Tel Aviv University
history: Tel Aviv University  is a public research university in Tel Aviv, Israel. With over 30,000 students, it is the largest university in the country.

name: Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn
history: The University of Bonn, officially the Rhenish Friedrich Wilhelm University of Bonn , is a public research university located in Bonn, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.

name: Universität Hamburg
history: The University of Hamburg  is a public research university in Hamburg, Germany.

name: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
history: UAB was created by decree in June 1968. Its first four faculties covered humanities, medicine, science and economics, and teaching began that October.

name: Chulalongkorn University
history: Chulalongkorn University , nicknamed Chula , is a public autonomous research university in Bangkok, Thailand.

name: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU)
history: Hamad Bin Khalifa University was founded in 2010 within Qatar Foundation's education and research ecosystem. Its development centres on graduate education and research connected to Qatar and the wider region.

name: Keio University
history: Keio University , abbreviated as Keio  or Keidai , is a private research university located in Minato, Tokyo, Japan. It was originally established as a school for Western studies in 1858 in Edo.

name: Massey University
history: Massey University  is a university based in New Zealand, with significant campuses in Auckland, Palmerston North,  and Wellington.

name: Hong Kong Baptist University
history: Hong Kong Baptist University  is a public liberal arts university with a Christian education heritage in Kowloon Tong, Kowloon, Hong Kong.

name: United Arab Emirates University
history: United Arab Emirates University   is a public research university located in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates.

name: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg
history: The University of Erlangen Nuremberg  is a public research university in the cities of Erlangen and Nuremberg in Bavaria, Germany.

name: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem
history: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem  is an Israeli public research university based in Jerusalem.

name: University College Cork
history: University College Cork   National University of Ireland, Cork   is a constituent university of the National University of Ireland, and located in Cork.

name: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore
history: The Indian Institute of Science  is a public, deemed, research university for higher education and research in science, engineering, design, and management. It is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

history: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur  is a public institute of technology located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India.

name: American University of Beirut (AUB)
history: The American University of Beirut  is a private, non-sectarian, and independent university chartered in New York with its campus in Beirut, Lebanon.

name: University of Twente
history: The University of Twente  ˈtʋɛntə]; abbr. UT) is a public technical university located in Enschede, Netherlands.

name: University of Gothenburg
history: The University of Gothenburg  is a university in Sweden's second largest city, Gothenburg.

name: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid
history: The university was created in 1968 during Spain's expansion of public higher education. Its first classes used several sites in Madrid; the Cantoblanco campus opened in 1971.

name: Deakin University
history: Deakin University is a public university in Victoria, Australia. Founded in 1974, the university was named after Alfred Deakin, the second Prime Minister of Australia.

name: University of Florida
history: The University of Florida  is a public land-grant research university in Gainesville, Florida, United States. It is a senior member of the State University System of Florida.

name: University of Ottawa
history: The University of Ottawa , often referred to as uOttawa or U of O, is a bilingual public research university in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.

name: Eberhard Karls Universität Tübingen

name: Griffith University
history: Griffith University is a public research university in South East Queensland on the east coast of Australia. The university was founded in 1971, but was not officially opened until 1975.

name: University of Strathclyde
history: The University of Strathclyde  is a public research university located in Glasgow, Scotland.

name: Universidad de los Andes
history: The University of the Andes , also commonly self-styled as Uniandes, is a private research university located in the city centre of Bogotá, Colombia.

name: University of Lausanne
history: The University of Lausanne  in Lausanne, Switzerland, was founded in 1537 as a school of Protestant theology, before being made a university in 1890.

name: École Normale Supérieure de Lyon
history: The École normale supérieure de Lyon  is a French grande école located in the city of Lyon.

name: Tianjin University
history: Tianjin University , previously Peiyang University , is a national public research university in Tianjin, China.

name: Beijing Normal University
history: Beijing Normal University  is a public university in Beijing, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Education of China, and co-funded by the Ministry of Education and the Beijing Municipal People's Government.

name: University of Lisbon
history: The University of Lisbon  is a public research university in Lisbon, and Portugal's largest university.

name: Central European University
history: CEU developed in the early 1990s as an English-language postgraduate education and research project. Its early institutional history included colleges in Prague and Budapest, described in the university's 1993-94 academic publication.

name: Queensland University of Technology (QUT)
history: The Queensland University of Technology  is a public research university located in the coastal city of Brisbane in Queensland, Australia.

name: La Trobe University
history: La Trobe University is a public research university based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Its main campus is located in the suburb of Bundoora.

name: Victoria University of Wellington
history: Victoria University of Wellington  is a public research university in Wellington, New Zealand. It was established in 1897 by Act of Parliament, and was a constituent college of the University of New Zealand.

name: Beijing Institute of Technology
history: The Beijing Institute of Technology  is a public university in Haidian, Beijing, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

name: The University of Newcastle, Australia (UON)
history: The University of Newcastle in Australia was established in 1965. Its own historical student guide records this foundation date; it is distinct from Newcastle University in the United Kingdom.

name: Albert-Ludwigs-Universitaet Freiburg
history: The University of Freiburg , officially the Albert Ludwig University of Freiburg , is a public research university located in Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg,…

name: Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne
history: Paris 1's modern multidisciplinary project dates from 1971. It combines humanities and social sciences with a historical connection to the medieval Sorbonne tradition, rather than treating the medieval college as the same modern institution.

name: University of Surrey
history: The University of Surrey is a public research university in Guildford, Surrey, England. The university received its royal charter in 1966, along with a number of other institutions following recommendations in the Robbins Report.

name: Universite libre de Bruxelles
history: The Université libre de Bruxelles  is a French-speaking research university in Brussels, Belgium.

name: University of Calgary
history: The University of Calgary  is a public research university located in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

name: University of Rochester
history: The University of Rochester is a private research university in Rochester, New York, United States. It was founded in 1850 and moved into its current campus, next to the Genesee River in 1955.

name: University of California, Irvine
history: The University of California, Irvine  is a public land-grant research university in Irvine, California, United States.

name: University of Maryland, College Park
history: The University of Maryland, College Park  is a public land-grant research university in College Park, Maryland, United States.

name: Maastricht University
history: Maastricht University  is a public research university in Maastricht, the Netherlands. Founded in 1976, it is the second youngest of the thirteen Dutch universities.

name: University of Minnesota (System)
history: The University of Minnesota Twin Cities  is a public land-grant research university in the Twin Cities of Minneapolis and Saint Paul, Minnesota, United States.

name: University of Porto
history: The University of Porto  is a Portuguese public research university located in Porto, and founded on 22 March 1911.

name: University of Canterbury
history: The University of Canterbury  is a public research university based in Christchurch, New Zealand.

name: American University of Sharjah
history: The American University of Sharjah  is a private university in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. It was founded in 1997 by Sultan bin Muhammad Al-Qasimi, Supreme Council Member and Ruler of Sharjah.

name: Sun Yat-sen University
history: Sun Yat-sen University  is a public research university in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Education, and co-funded by the Ministry of Education, SASTIND, and Guangdong Provincial Government.

name: University of Massachusetts Amherst
history: The University of Massachusetts is the five-campus public university system in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

name: Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP)
history: Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS  is a private Malaysian Research university established in 10th January 1997. It is wholly owned by Petroliam Nasional Berhad , Malaysia's oil and gas multinational corporation.

history: The University of Göttingen, officially the Georg August University of Göttingen , is a public research university in the city of Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany.

name: Universitat Pompeu Fabra (Barcelona)
history: Pompeu Fabra University  is a public university located in the city of Barcelona, Catalonia in Spain.

history: The Norwegian University of Science and Technology  is a public research university in Norway and the largest in terms of enrollment.

name: Vanderbilt University
history: Vanderbilt University  is a private research university in Nashville, Tennessee, United States.

name: Singapore University of Technology and Design
history: SUTD was established in 2009 with a curriculum built around design and interdisciplinary engineering. Its early development involved collaboration with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

name: University of Macau
history: The University of Macau  is an international comprehensive research public university of Macau.

name: University of Virginia
history: Thomas Jefferson founded the University of Virginia in 1819. Its establishment was authorised through Virginia legislation in January of that year.

name: University of Cologne
history: The University of Cologne  is a university in Cologne, Germany. It was established in 1388. It closed in 1798 before being re-established in 1919.

name: Dartmouth College
history: Dartmouth College  is a private Ivy League research university in Hanover, New Hampshire, United States.

name: Taylor's University
history: Taylor's traces its educational heritage to Taylor's College, founded in 1969. The university's later development includes the Lakeside Campus; the college's foundation date describes the predecessor, not an assertion that university status began in 1969.

name: Charles University
history: Charles University , or historically as the University of Prague , is the largest university in the Czech Republic.

name: University of Sussex
history: The University of Sussex is a public research university located in Falmer, East Sussex, England. It lies mostly within the city boundaries of Brighton and Hove.
